topic: Your brain's best guess 1: Reaching out means more than you think
caption:
Reaching out means more than you think.

The prediction: a quick “thought of you” message is no big deal.

In experiments, people who reached out tended to underestimate how much the other person appreciated it. Being thought of seemed to matter more to the receiver than the sender expected.

Something to try: maybe send a short “thought of you” message today.

Your brain's best guess is our series on everyday predictions that research suggests are often too pessimistic. Studies were mostly with US participants, so results may differ for you.

Research: Liu, P. J., Rim, S., Min, L., & Min, K. E. (2023). The surprise of reaching out: Appreciated more than we think. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 124(4), 754-771. https://doi.org/10.1037/pspi0000402
